cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: We Needed the Break
cards.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just us for lunch. That failed family reunion was a useful trial; we know the right format now. Two people, one conversation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We shouted over each other until everyone left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Too many competing speakers. The failure showed us that. We'll take turns today, please, without recruiting an audience.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter has laid fourteen places. He's asking if we're expecting twelve more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him two diners in total, nobody else coming. Ask him to clear the other twelve settings, please. We need room to hear each other.
